subtitle: Live Inspired
logline: Laurent Goldstein's latest documentary on health and longevity, about living an inspired life after 50.
excerpt: Laurent Goldstein's latest documentary on health and longevity, about living an inspired life after 50.
html:
Your Second Fifty 2: Live Inspired is a documentary about health and longevity. It looks at how to break free from limitations, rediscover your potential and live your most inspired life after 50.

Featured in the film

Drs. Bruce Lipton, Joy Kong, Dale Bredesen, Jeffrey Thompson, Nona Djavid, Patrick Porter, Eric and Stephanie Venn-Watson, Jeffrey Gross, Nick Shork, Fabrizio Mancini, Jeffrey Spencer, Anna Cabeca, Margaret Christensen, Robert Vasquez and Randy Johns.

Plus Jay Campbell, Mike McIntyre, Susan Bratton, Elias Arjan and Elisa 'Wowza' Lodge.

Produced by Citrus Pie Media Group. Follow the film on the Your Second Fifty Life YouTube channel.
